纸间 1.0.1

Electron 43.2.0 (MIT and Chromium third-party licenses)
https://github.com/electron/electron
Runtime LICENSE and LICENSES.chromium.html are included in the portable directory.

Foliate JS (MIT)
https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js
Pinned source commit: 78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1
Retrieved 2026-10-29 from the official repository.
Local changes: remove allow-scripts from chapter iframe sandboxes; reject encrypted
MOBI headers; add HUFF recursion / expansion guards, record and total text bounds,
and zero TAGX mask protection. Additional safe ZIP loading and chapter sanitation
are implemented in formats.js outside the vendor code.
Paginator rendering also guards against layout callbacks arriving before a chapter
document body exists or after that document has been detached.

zip.js 2.8.22 (BSD-3-Clause)
https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js
Vendored through Foliate JS; license: zip.js-LICENSE.txt.

fflate 0.8.2 (MIT)
https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
Vendored through Foliate JS; license: fflate-LICENSE.txt.

Build tools (not required to run the portable app):
@electron/asar 3.4.1; resedit 1.7.2; @napi-rs/canvas; Playwright.

Original sample stories: written for this application. Freely usable for reading,
copying, distribution and testing. No user book library was accessed or uploaded.
